name: Betsson AB (publ)
summary: Betsson AB (publ) engages in the online gaming business worldwide. It offers casino games, sports betting, and other forms of gaming, such as poker and bingo. The company provides its products under the Betsson, Betsafe, Starcasino, Inkabet, betFirst, Nordicbet, Racebets, Rizk, and Jalla Casino brands. The company was formerly known as Cherryföretagen AB and changed its name to Betsson AB (publ) in July 2006. Betsson AB (publ) was incorporated in 1963 and is based in Stockholm, Sweden.
